stem:
In the Venn diagram shown, Set A contains shapes with one given characteristic and Set B contains shapes with another characteristic.

Which shape most likely belongs in the intersection of Set A and Set B?

options.label: C
options.text: [image of polygon with one slanting side]

visual_elements: Venn diagram with Set A labeled "Polygons with at least one right angle," Set B with three shapes, including parallelograms without right angles
